plainText:
Jessie's Frillish (Japanese: ムサシのプルリル Musashi's Pururill) is the second Pokémon that Jessie obtained in the Unova region, and her ninth overall.

==History==
=== ===
 
Jessie's Frillish first appeared in New Places... Familiar Faces!, debuting along with James's Amoonguss when attacked and for the first time since their Operation Tempest and temporary retreat back to Kanto.

When Ash and friends were helping Nanette gain some experience, Team Rocket surprised them, sent out their new Pokémon, and used a combination of Mist and on them and their Pokémon, reducing the visibility to almost nothing and paralyzing Iris's Emolga and Cilan's Stunfisk at the same time, thus leaving Ash alone to face Team Rocket with . After Amoonguss had successfully knocked Pikachu out, Jessie had use Psychic, lifting Pikachu into the air and towards Team Rocket's . However, thanks to the distraction provided by Nanette and her , Pikachu was freed, although Tepig got caught in the process. For a getaway distraction, Team Rocket fired a combination of Bubble Beam and , which, much to their surprise, was endured by Ash's Unfezant, followed by an and an to defeat Frillish and Amoonguss.

In The Name's N!, Jessie sent Frillish out after catching Pikachu. She distracted Ash from holding on to his when Snivy used to grab onto their balloon. Frillish once again battled Unfezant and used Bubble Beam on her, but Unfezant dodged and used to free Pikachu. Pikachu joined in the battle and tried to finish off Team Rocket with , but Amoonguss's Stun Spore paralyzed him before the attack completely blasted them off. Frillish was taken out along with Amoonguss by Unfezant's which slammed them into Team Rocket's balloon causing it to be blasted away.
 
After Team Plasma took control of Meowth with their machine in Meowth, Colress and Team Rivalry!, Jessie and James decided to attack their friend in order to get him out of the trance. After Amoonguss used to paralyze Meowth and to incapacitate him, Frillish brought Meowth back to Jessie and James with Psychic. Having Meowth out of Team Plasma's control, Team Rocket managed to get out of their headquarters using Frillish's Mist.

In Best Wishes Until We Meet Again!, Frillish battled Ash and for the final time in Unova. Working with Amoonguss, the two threw Ash, , and into the cruise ship's cargo hold, giving Team Rocket the time to steal all of the Poké Balls on the ship. Right as they were about to make their escape, Ash's Charizard appeared and made quick work of them with .

Frillish was given away to for Team Rocket in The Dream Continues!.

=== ===
In Rocket Revengers!, Frillish, alongside the rest of Team Rocket's Pokémon at , were sent to Jessie and James so they could be added back to their team. Realizing the potential of such a large group, the team hatched a scheme to isolate Ash's Pikachu and capture him. Frillish and were the second to do so, distracting and her Pokémon while Ash and Pikachu ran ahead. Upon getting a distress signal from , the two returned to their Trainers to take on Pikachu as a group. She joined all of Team Rocket to launch a combined attack at the Mouse Pokémon. However, it was dodged, and ended up sending it back with . A wild that had been following Ash then intervened and sent the evil group blasting off.

==Personality and characteristics==
In contrast to James's Amoonguss, Frillish was considered to be more mischievous in the group. She had little trouble following Jessie's commands, as shown when she used Psychic to lift up anything. Similar to Jessie's previous Pokémon, Frillish's Mist was proven to be very effective as a way for Team Rocket to retreat.

==Trivia==
Not counting temporary Pokémon, Frillish was Jessie's first type, as well as her first type.
Not counting temporary Pokémon or Growlie, who never appeared on James's team, Frillish holds the record for the least appearances out of Team Rocket's Pokémon, at 9 main series episodes.
Frillish is the only non-temporary Pokémon owned by Team Rocket to possess gender differences in her debut, as gender differences did not exist when and were obtained in .
Not counting temporary Pokémon, Frillish was the first of Team Rocket Pokémon to have had a unique type combination.
